name: basic minify
input:
SELECT
  a,
  b
FROM
  c
WHERE
  d = 1;
output: SELECT a,b FROM c WHERE d=1;

name: remove comments
input:
select /* comment */ a -- comment
 from t;

name: inline block comment
input: SELECT a /* block */ , b FROM t;

name: string keeps its spaces and keywords
input:
SELECT   'a  b  FROM x'   AS s
FROM   t
output: SELECT'a  b  FROM x'AS s FROM t

name: postgres dollar quoting and cast
input:
SELECT  $$a  ;  b$$ ,  x :: int
FROM  t

name: operators and parameters keep their tokens
input:
SELECT a <> b , c >= ? , d || e
FROM t WHERE f = :name
output: SELECT a<>b,c>=?,d||e FROM t WHERE f=:name

name: block comment across lines removed
input:
SELECT a
/* multi
   line */
FROM t
